parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left cabinet door made of MDF, forming one of the two front panels of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a hinged cover to enclose and protect the contents of the cabinet, providing access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right cabinet door made of MDF, forming the other front panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the cabinet’s interior and provides access when opened, often used together with the left door.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer box that supports all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the doors and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving component that supports all other parts.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, forming a horizontal surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and helps distribute weight evenly across the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, forming a horizontal divider inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional storage level for organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable depending on design.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet made of particle board, forming the uppermost horizontal surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lighter items and helps maximize vertical storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
